create_MeshRenderer: create a MeshRenderer with a rasterizer and shader to render a batch of meshes into images
create_MeshRendererWithFragments: create a MeshRendererWithFragments to render meshes and return both images and fragments for depth extraction
run_MeshRenderer_forward: run the MeshRenderer forward pass on a batch of Meshes to produce rendered image tensors
run_MeshRendererWithFragments_forward: run the MeshRendererWithFragments forward pass to get rendered images and fragments including zbuf depth data
review_MeshRenderer_to: review the MeshRenderer to method which moves the rasterizer and shader to a specified device
